messages:
marta: Heads-up — we need a quick coordinated green sweep for the v2.5 bump. Cutoff is 10:00 UTC tomorrow. PR #4123 includes the version bump and changelog entries. I pushed a tiny fix to the bump script (see diff). Can owners please confirm they can run a sweep tonight or early tomorrow?

jonathan: ack, I can run a smoke sweep at 22:00 UTC tonight. I’ll look for flaky tests and mark any triage notes in the PR.

sam: I’m on call for test flakes. If CI shows >5 flaky failures I’ll start bisecting. Ping me when you kick the run.

marta: thanks. tagging owners that matter: @jonathan @sam @layla. main concerns: integration tests around kv-cache and model startup time. Also one flaky in `tests/serve/test_streaming.py` that sometimes times out.

layla: I’ll skim changelog for legal/credit stuff and confirm no customer-facing wording changes. quick question — did we bump the quantization tool version in the build image?

marta: good catch — yes, image uses quant-tool v1.3.2 now. I added it to the release notes.

release-bot: CI status for branch release/v2.5 — latest pipeline: failed (3 failed jobs). Rerun command: `/ci rerun pipeline release/v2.5`

jonathan: running the pipeline now. copying the failing jobs to thread: `unit-tests-linux`, `integration-gpu`, `smoke-deploy`

ci-bot: `unit-tests-linux` rerun queued. ETA ~6m.

sam: quick triage note: the `integration-gpu` failures look like timeouts on the model load step — increasing the startup timeout by 10s in the test fixes it locally. I’ll open a tiny patch if the rerun persists.

jonathan: rerun finished — unit-tests green, integration-gpu still failing 2/3. I retried the job manually with increased timeout env: `TEST_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=40`. kicking it again.

layla: small doc note — we should add a changelog line: "Updated quantization tooling to v1.3.2 — runtime perf fixes". I'll add to PR.

marta: if integration-gpu stays flaky after timeout bump, plan B: fall back to model-variant `gpt-small` for the smoke-deploy job to keep release on track, then follow up with fix and backport. Thoughts?

sam: agree. fallback variant makes sense for the smoke gate only. I’ll prepare a conditional in the smoke job: `if integration-gpu fails then use MODEL_VARIANT=gpt-small`. I’ll push the job tweak to the CI config and mark it as temporary.

jonathan: pushed the CI tweak in a temporary commit on the release branch. Rerunning smoke-deploy now.

release-bot: smoke-deploy succeeded (with fallback variant). All required gates green.

marta: awesome — thanks team. Can folks please add final +1s to PR #4123 after you confirm changelog and bump script are fine? I’ll cut the release window and run the release job at 09:30 UTC tomorrow to allow a quick rollback window before 10:00 cutoff. :thumbsup:

sam: +1 (noted flaky triage steps in PR).

layla: +1 — changelog LGTM.

jonathan: +1. I left details about the timeout env and the fallback in the PR description.

marta: perfect. leaving this here for async follow-ups. if anything else crops up tonight DM me directly.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: release/v2.5 cutoff in 12h.

ci-bot: archived artifacts: logs + junit attached to PR #4123."
